Credits

Forest shader

The background is frorest-green by Allan Mesquita Brito, the exact 21st.dev Waves recipe selected for this site. Its shader and original four-color configuration run locally with a small native WebGL wrapper.

Shader attribution and MIT terms

Morphing headline

The headline adapts Morphing Text by Magic UI / Dillion Verma, using its blur and SVG threshold effect. Magic UI's documentation credits @luis-code. VineMix adds a shuffled phrase sequence and local motion controls.

Magic UI MIT license

VineMix identity

The logo and illustrative workspace preview are supplied by the VineMix project. Typography uses IBM Plex Sans.
